ruleset.name: Strict Explicitness Rules
ruleset.description: The explicitness ruleset plus two stricter rules that also treat an instance method's own object as implicit: reading its fields and properties is an implicit input, and changing them is an implicit output. Constructors and static methods are exempt.

rule.name: ImplicitInstanceInput
rule.description: An instance method reads a field, property or primary constructor parameter of its own instance (bare or through this/base). The data comes from the object rather than the argument list. Pass it in, or make the method static.

rule.name: ImplicitInstanceOutput
rule.description: An instance method writes a field or property of its own instance, or changes the object that one holds. The result leaves through the object rather than the return value. Return a new value instead.
